home.title: Home
home.intro: Your shared planner for a long-distance relationship.

status.none: You do not have a shared space yet.

create.title: Create a new space
create.hint: Afterwards you get an invite code to pass on.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.explanation: Pass this code on to your partner. It works only once.
invite.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select the code and copy it yourself.
invite.renewHint: The old code stops working immediately.
invite.noCode: There is no valid invite code right now.
invite.gotCode: Did you get a code yourself? Then leave this space first.

name.label: Your display name
name.hint: This is how your partner sees you. {max} characters at most.

leave.title: Leave this space?
leave.paired: You lose access to your shared dates and photos. They are not deleted: they stay in the space, and whoever joins it later can see them. Your saved location is removed.
leave.alone: You are the only person in this space. If you leave, nobody can get into it again, not even you. Dates and photos are not deleted, but they can no longer be reached in the app. The invite code stops working and your location is removed.

hint.none: Create a shared space or join one with a code.
hint.waiting: Your space is still waiting for your partner.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.

api.inviteInvalid: This invitation is invalid or has already been used.
api.alreadyPaired: You already belong to a shared space.
api.noSpace: Create or join a shared space first.
api.quotaExceeded: The storage for your shared photos is full (50 MB per couple). Delete a photo to free up space.
api.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
api.internal: The server has a problem right now. Please try again later.

auth.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is wrong.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email address first, using the link we sent you.

auth.emailInvalid: This email address is not accepted.
auth.weakPassword: This password is too weak. Choose a longer one.
auth.signupDisabled: New registrations are not possible at the moment.
auth.methodDisabled: This way of signing in is not available at the moment.
auth.rejected: Sign-in was rejected. Please check what you entered.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is not available at the moment.

form.emailInvalid: That is not a valid email address.

form.inviteCodeShape: A code has 32 characters: digits and the letters a to f.
form.displayNameTooLong: The name can have {max} characters at most.
form.displayNameInvalid: Please enter a name with 1 to {max} characters.

space.alreadyInSpace: You are already in a space.

space.partnerJoined: Someone has joined in the meantime.
space.noLongerInSpace: You are no longer in a space.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.confirmationSent: Almost done: we sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it in this browser if you can.
